DDInter973.mechanism: Coadministration with inhibitors of CYP450 3A4 and/or UGT1A1 may increase the plasma concentrations of irinotecan and its active metabolite, SN-38. High plasma levels of irinotecan and SN-38 may increase the risk of potentially fatal toxicities such as severe diarrhea, neutropenia, sepsis, and thromboembolism.
